senses.gloss: c. (קְטַר II, with anorg. נ) knot, knotted web as of matting, sieves &c.; laces or ropes drawn transversely.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:7:4">Y. Meg. III, 74ᵇ</cite> bot. (describing the arrangement of <cite ref="Esther 9:6-10">Esth. IX, 6-10</cite>, beginning with <cite ref="A01615"><he>איש</he></cite> on one side, under which the names of the sons of Haman are arranged in a column, and with <he>ואת</he> on the other side, v. <cite ref="A03092"><he>אָרִיחַ</he></cite>) [read:] <he>שכן הוא שניץ ונחיץ כהדין קינטרה</he> so that (in reading transversely) it appears laced and closely corded like transverse lacing (of a web); [Beth Jos. to Ṭur Or. Ḥayim 691 <cite ref="S01558"><he>קנטירא</he></cite>, read: <cite ref="S01038"><he>קינטרא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 13:6">Treat. Sof’rim XIII, 6</cite>, variously corrupted].—Pl. <cite ref="S00432"><he>קוּנְטְרָן</he></cite>. Y. Sabb. VIII, 10ᶜ top <he>ההן דעבד ק׳ נפן וכ׳</he> (Or Zaruʿa <cite ref="Shabbat 64a">Sabb. 64</cite> <he>קוּשְׁרָן מנפן</he>) he who makes (on the Sabbath) knotted (corded) webs, sieves, mats &c.
